summary: The repository ceases to be the fundamental unit; a CapabilityCell is modeled as C_i=(I,O,T,P,E,U,R,M), with inputs, outputs, transformation, preconditions, evidence, uncertainty, resources and memory.
A provider-independent intermediate representation is proposed so multiple implementations can realize the same semantic capability; code is explicitly distinguished from capability.
Natural-language research intent is compiled into an executable capability/repository graph, with a dynamic graph whose edges depend on current intent, state and available capabilities.
Hyperedges are promoted from descriptive relations to executable first-class orchestration objects connecting multiple capabilities.
Repositories carry claim, evidence, uncertainty, provenance, security and limit metadata so trust decisions can be capability-specific rather than global.

construct: Ecosystem Contract Tests + Semantic CI + Scientific CI
summary: Cross-repository contracts test producer-consumer compatibility; Semantic CI checks meaning and units; Scientific CI requires baselines, controls, uncertainty, provenance, statistics, counter-hypotheses and reproducibility beyond ordinary software CI.
A theory is compiled into an executable research program/repository graph, while code, tests, docs, benchmarks and history are mined for an implicit theory.
The two compilers are linked through a semantic difference operator intended to expose divergence between theory and implementation.

Recursive improvement is bounded by rules such as generation != truth, passed test != proven scientific claim, provenance requirements, preservation of negative memory and higher validation for kernel changes; OAK itself must be evaluated for calibration and failure modes.

construct: Hypergraph fixed point + Mycelial Fixed-Point Test
summary: Self-hosting is framed as approximate reconstruction of a functionally equivalent system from its own language, schemas, manifests, capability graphs, tests and compilers; compressibility and reproducibility are proposed as measurable objectives.
Residuals are transformed into competing candidate explanations and discriminating tests rather than directly into preferred explanations.
Theory -> Code -> Evidence -> RevisedTheory creates a residual Delta_T intended to measure theory/implementation/evidence correspondence.
